name: explain
prompt:
REFERENCE: the attached model sheet shows the character; keep its face, hair, hair clip, glasses, clothes, colors, proportions and paper-cut style exactly the same.
CHARACTER: an original science-communicator mascot: a friendly young researcher about two and a half heads tall, short dark-brown hair with a soft side part and one small cowlick, a small ochre hair clip on the left side, round thin navy-rimmed glasses, a round face with dot eyes, light blush and a small smile, a navy cardigan over a cream round-collar shirt, warm brown trousers, simple brown shoes, and a small ochre notebook as a signature prop; drawn as layered cut paper with visible paper grain, clean dark outlines and soft shadows.
POSE: holding the open ochre notebook toward the viewer with both hands, explaining, lively expression. Exactly one character, full body.
BACKGROUND: plain flat off-white background with nothing else in the scene, the whole body visible with a generous empty margin, only a soft contact shadow under the feet.
AVOID: no resemblance to existing anime, cartoon or game characters; no white or spiky hair; no black outfit; no text, letters, digits, logos or symbols anywhere.
